thread:
olivia (partnerships): quick sync — proposing a slim pilot with LangChain + BridgeKit gateway + OrchX for tooling integration. goal: sandbox POC + coordinated announce runway. thoughts? :eyes:

sam (eng-tools): curious what 'slim' means here. do we mean no marketplace listing initially, just sandbox creds and an adapter?

olivia (partnerships): yes. narrow scope: 1) adapter dev kit + sample app, 2) hosted sandbox with limited tokens, 3) telemetry hooks for model/method usage. no public marketplace tile for phase 1.

jordan (solutions): must confirm auth flow for SSO + token exchange. clients will expect gRPC/websocket gateway compatibility. any constraints on callback URLs for OrchX?

sam (eng-tools): technically we can do OAuth2 code grant or signed JWT exchange. minimal adapter example (pseudo):
```yaml
adapter:
  name: bridgekit-langchain
  auth: jwt
  endpoints:
    - /v1/generate
    - /v1/kv-sync
```
we'll need CORS and websocket proxy in the gateway.

deepa (product): telemetry: we need per-route cost and latency, plus prompt-set tagging so Optimize can run regression checks. also want a short prompt template bundled so partners don't ship with bad defaults.

olivia (partnerships): agreed. phase 1 success criteria (proposal):
- sandbox integration validated with 3 sample flows (chat, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings)
- telemetry showing latency and cost per flow
- partner signed off on adapter docs + quickstart
- joint blog + demo recording scheduled (tentative)

andre (marketing): for the announce runway: prefer soft launch (partner blog + demo) then marketplace tile in phase 2. embargo window needed — default to 2 weeks pre-announce for assets. who will own demo recording?

jordan (solutions): our SI teams want a little more on ops: playbook for tenant isolation, secrets rotation, and fallback models when capacity constrained. can we include those as a single markdown checklist?

olivia (partnerships): yes. I'll draft a one-pager playbook and share. outline items: onboarding, SSO + jwt exchange, tenant quotas, model fallback policy (e.g., redwood-1 -> redwood-1-small), monitoring runbook, contact matrix.

sam (eng-tools): one technical ask: the adapter SDK should expose a small validation harness so partners can run local smoke tests. sample command: `./bridgekit validate --endpoint https://sandbox.redwood.ai --token $TOKEN`

ci-bot: build 0e7a3 passed for bridgekit-adapter (main). artifacts uploaded to: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/0e7a3

deepa (product): timeline proposal:
- Week 0: adapter scaffold + quickstart (internal review)
- Week 1: partner integration + telemetry hooks
- Week 2: smoke tests + demo recording
- Week 3: soft announce (partner blog + social)

andre (marketing): tagging onto Week 3 works. need logo assets, one-liner, and demo script by end of Week 2. I'll own outreach to PR.

olivia (partnerships): action items: @sam to finalize SDK validation by Thu, @deepa to add telemetry schema, @jordan to draft SI ops checklist, @andre to prep announce template. I'll send calendar invites for weekly check-ins.

sam (eng-tools): ack — will push a validation PR by EOD Thu.

jordan (solutions): will start the ops checklist, ping if we need any infra changes.

deepa (product): starting telemetry schema now, will share draft in this thread.

andre (marketing): collecting logo + short quote from BridgeKit. who is the BridgeKit contact?

olivia (partnerships): pinging them now in DM.

sam (eng-tools): small note: OrchX needs a configured route timeout default of 15s for RAG streaming flows — else we see premature cuts on long-generations. we should call that out in the quickstart.

olivia (partnerships): good catch. adding to quickstart checklist.

andre (marketing): can we get a 30s clip of the demo for socials? that usually helps pickup.

olivia (partnerships): yes — demo script will include a 30s highlight.

ci-bot: reminder — scheduled sandbox maintenance on 1716279000 (UTC). small window ~10m.

sam (eng-tools): noted — we'll avoid running heavy validation during that window.

olivia (partnerships): thanks everyone. I'll drop the draft one-pager and timeline by tomorrow morning. :raised_hands:
